note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Page title bar -- renders: 'Search' heading and 'Help' link
Appearance settings panel -- renders: 'Appearance' label, 'Unpin' button, font size options (Small, Standard, Large), width options (Standard, Full width), theme options (OS, Day, Night)
Search input controls -- renders: search field, 'Search' button, and result count label
Advanced search options toggle -- renders: 'Search options' button and preview of selected filters
Namespace filter toggle -- renders: 'Namespaces' button and preview of selected namespaces (e.g., 'Main')
Create article prompt -- renders: 'Create the page' link and explanatory text about creating missing articles
Results per page selector -- renders: dropdown with options (10, 20, 50, 100, 250)

Site footer -- renders: Privacy policy, About Wikipedia, Disclaimers, Contact Wikipedia, Legal & safety contacts, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation logo, Powered by MediaWiki logo
